record.t: Became chief justice of the Pennsylvania Supreme Court after Chief Justice Max Baer's death in 2022, as its longest-serving member; the state's first female chief justice.
record.q: Chief Justice Max Baer’s death in late September 2022 elevated Todd to the court’s top spot because she has served longer than any of her colleagues.

record.t: Was elected to the Pennsylvania Supreme Court in 2007 after eight years on the Superior Court.
